contexts.text: Very few days intervene after the death of the body before they are in the other life; for it is a continuation of life.
Preface [3]. It has been granted me... to be in spirit in the other life... and there to speak with Souls who had risen again not long after their death...
After death (this blessedness of the affections) manifests itself...
Hence it is that after death a man becomes an Angel if he has lived according to Divine order...
I have spoken with some after two days from death...
Most of the learned are amazed, when, after death, they see themselves in a body...
As soon as little children are resuscitated, which takes place immediately after death, they are carried into Heaven...
The delight of love truly conjugial... becomes the delight of Heaven after death...
Every day there are dying from this Earth several thousands of men... all of whom, after their death, have come and are constantly coming into the... Spiritual World.
Men, after their death, as soon as they come into the Spiritual World, are accurately distinguished by the Lord...
I have spoken with some on the third day after their death...
This state is the first state of men after death.
When they enter the Spiritual World, which is usually on the third day after death...
